initialSimulation.title: Client's initial simulation
initialSimulation.subtitle: Figures as simulated when the case was created: kept even after a rate/amount/duration change

demandDetail.noEligibleUser: No eligible user (required grade/team not filled).
demandDetail.commentHint: Does not advance or assign the case: visible in the comments below.

classify.legendHint: The account officer contacts the client to confirm the request is genuine before attaching it to their portfolio.
classify.searchingMatch: Searching for an existing enterprise matching
classify.clientRibHint: Optional: will pre-fill the RIB suggested to the client when they declare a payment (they can still change it).

advance.assignedToOther2: only that person can advance or return it. Switch to "Assign / reassign" mode to assign it to yourself first.
advance.mandatory: Required: designate who takes ownership of the case at
advance.lastStepHint: Last step: the case will be closed, no owner to designate.
advance.rateDecisionHint: Keep preserves the case's current rate. Manual entry applies a value chosen by the person holding the profile required at this step.
advance.noRateYet: This case does not have a known applicable rate yet: "Keep" is unavailable; choose "Manual entry".
advance.amountDecisionHint: A manual entry automatically re-checks the financing ratio (amount/revenue), guarantee coverage and the client's debt ratio: the change is rejected if it exceeds these limits. Only the profile required at this step can advance the case.
advance.durationDecisionHint: A manual entry must stay between 12 and 300 months. Like the amount, it affects the debt ratio, which is re-checked on every change.
advance.onlyDecisionStep: Only available at the Committee Decision step.
advance.onlyCommitteeProgStep: Only available at the Committee Scheduling step.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.adiSubscribed: ADI (death/disability insurance) subscribed for the guarantor
insurance.adiHint: Required to advance this demand: covers the guarantor/company director in case of death or disability (BAM/ACAPS).
insurance.damageSubscribed: Damage / multi-risk insurance on real guarantees subscribed
insurance.damageHint: Required because this demand carries real guarantees (pledge/mortgage/lien): the policy must name the bank as beneficiary.
insurance.onlyInsuranceStep: Only available at the Insurance Validation step.

advance.noPreviousStep: No previous step: returning is not possible from the first step.
advance.returnHint: If filled in, the case is sent back to the previous step instead of advancing.
